posts.description: Interesting that in the Netherlands a lot of organizations preemptively took down websites and online applications running on PHP yesterday, but other countries were slow(er) to follow. Does that have to do with confidence in institutions being quite high here?
Nou, als je het echt wil weten…
Good comment on the Dots (OpenAI) and Muse (Meta) agent branding: I see we’re now in our “make agentic LLMs as cute as possible so we go easy on them when they dox us” era.
